candidates.name: OVVO V-1230R
candidates.use: 18 mm plywood carcass, concealed releasable click joints
candidates.assembly: Manufacturer describes hand push/click, no screws/glue/tools for joining prepared panels.

candidates.local_availability: Russian Virutex catalog lists SKU 7905029, box of 100. No confirmed retail stock/delivery found. MDM lists the special cutter; that does not prove connectors are available.

candidates.local_availability: No verified Russian stock or small-order delivery found.

candidates.name: PEANUT Drawer Runner

candidates.assembly: Insert and slide into specially routed slot; removal uses a flat-head screwdriver.
candidates.preparation: Special PEANUT cutter and manufacturer's precise routing instructions.
candidates.local_availability: Manufacturer directs initial purchase to REME. Russian availability and current delivery unconfirmed.

candidates.name: RSI / Alumica 30x30, slot 8
candidates.assembly: Ordinary connectors use screws and require a key. No checked tool-free version selected.
candidates.preparation: Cut lengths, fastening system, hole locations and optional end threads must be specified together.
candidates.local_availability: Russian primary suppliers list cutting and fittings; exact black finish and whole bill of materials not confirmed.

rejected_or_not_applicable.name: Hafele SC 8/25
rejected_or_not_applicable.reason: Recommended for small furniture, depth at most 400 mm and perimeter 2H+2W at most 3000 mm; our 500 mm-deep 1000x1200 mm cabinet exceeds both. Permanent connection. Not selected for our carcass.

rejected_or_not_applicable.name: Hafele SC 8/60 as allegedly tool-free final assembly
rejected_or_not_applicable.reason: Final tightening is a 180-degree turn with an SW3 hex key. Insertion without tools does not mean complete assembly without tools.

rejected_or_not_applicable.name: Titus Quickfit TL5 as allegedly entirely tool-free
rejected_or_not_applicable.reason: Dowel inserts by hand but the cam still has to be tightened. Do not equate tool-free dowel insertion with tool-free cabinet assembly.
